evidence.observation: O2 at 3.3 ppm after the purge, the baseline for ramp and early growth (~3-6 ppm)
O2 has risen every reading: 11.6, 18.8, 23.3, 32.4 ppm between 2760 and 3120 s
Pressure steady at ~760 Torr, so an exhaust blockage is unlikely
Ar flow tracks the 100 sccm setpoint, so a stuck MFC is unlikely
Temperature holds 750 C with plausible heater power

args.missing_evidence: A leak check (isolate the tube and watch for O2 or pressure changes, or sniff the fittings) would confirm the seal leak. Reference ranges for O2 during growth would also help. There is no characterization of the sample yet.
